desc:
📦 Build your truck. Load your packages. See how far you can deliver!

🎲 Roll for engines, wheels, fuel tanks, and rare parts!
🔨 Build a custom delivery truck your way.
🚚 Catch packages and carry them across challenging biomes.
🌵 Dodge obstacles, climb mountain roads, and watch for city traffic!
💰 Earn cash from deliveries to upgrade your build.
🍀 Improve your luck, get more golden rolls, and unlock bigger package drops!
💾 Save your favorite builds and keep creating.

Can you make it to the post office?
